name: chat_to_gemini_sse_midstream_invalid
_comment: Post-commit truncation: upstream Gemini SSE sends one valid text chunk (already forwarded downstream) then an invalid frame. The router holds HTTP 200 and aborts silently with no success marker and no error frame: no terminal finish, no [DONE].
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.gem]
dialect = "gemini"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "gem-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-gem"
provider = "gem"
model = "gemini-2.0-flash"
